name: Cloudflare Workers AI
summary: Direct local REST inference with account-wide Neuron allocation; no Worker deployment required.

credentials.label: Workers AI API token
credentials.help: Workers AI Read and Edit permissions for the chosen account.

setupSteps.title: Select your Cloudflare account
setupSteps.description: Copy its Account ID from Workers AI in the dashboard.

setupSteps.title: Create a Workers AI API token
setupSteps.description: Use the Workers AI template, or grant Workers AI Read and Edit for the selected account.

setupSteps.title: Choose direct REST access
setupSteps.description: Configure the account-specific /ai/v1 base URL. A deployed Worker is unnecessary.

setupSteps.title: Qualify billing posture
setupSteps.description: Verify Workers Free versus Paid and AI Gateway billing before activating any free-only route.

billingPlans.name: Workers Free · daily allocation
billingPlans.notes: Neuron compute units are not tokens. Free plan stops at its allocation; certain models require paid billing.

billingPlans.name: Workers Paid / PAYG inference
billingPlans.notes: Usage above the included allocation is billed. Prepaid AI Gateway credits are a separate billing path, not a free fallback.

routes.name: Gemma 4 · Neuron allocation
routes.freeOnlyEnforcement: Require verified Workers Free billing posture, direct endpoint and current free-access model allowlist. Paid plan/AI Gateway credit billing can charge beyond allocation and cannot qualify automatically.

routes.name: GLM 4.7 Flash · Neuron allocation
routes.freeOnlyEnforcement: Free allocation is account-dependent; require verified Workers Free billing posture and direct access.

routes.name: Kimi K2.6 · paid access
restrictions: Requires Workers Paid plan or prepaid AI Gateway credits; excluded from free-only.
